The source preserves the existing process for pending applications; it does not expressly establish permanent ineligibility after withdrawal, replacement or later disposition. The explicit commencement date supports the date comparison. The absent issuance date prevents independent reconciliation with 'immediate effect'; this is not an established contradiction.
Home-jurisdiction compliance, materiality, novelty, complexity and possible local policy implications are supplied classifications. The formula does not establish their legal or factual accuracy.
The two unbound dependency IDs have no descriptive mapping. Neither can safely be assigned to the FAQs, forms, home-jurisdiction requirements or existing process.

FALSE means the proposed relief conditions are not satisfied, not that an independent approval obligation or non-compliance has been established. TRUE does not dispense with notification or continuing post-vetting.

The introductory reference to home-regulator supervision does not expressly add a separate approval or supervision predicate to the investment-change provision. Adding one would require further support.
The referenced FAQs are missing. Related forms and checklists are also absent, but the supplied text does not establish that they add substantive eligibility conditions.
